decks.notes: The deck utilizes the powerful combo potential of Underworld Breach in Vintage 1 vs 1 format. It includes various tutor spells and fast mana accelerants to help assemble the combo quickly. The deck also runs disruption spells like Force of Will and Lightning Bolt to protect the combo or disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key goal of the deck is to use Underworld Breach to recur key spells from the graveyard and generate a winning advantage through card advantage and mana efficiency. It aims to win the game quickly through a powerful combo finish.

The deck focuses on assembling its combo pieces, primarily Coveted Jewel, by using fast mana acceleration like Grim Monolith and Ancient Tomb. It aims to generate mana quickly to cast multiple spells in a turn, drawing cards with Paradoxical Outcome and tutoring with Tinker to find key pieces like Time Vault. It also utilizes disruptive elements such as Trinisphere and Force of Will to protect its combo. Additionally, Karn, the Great Creator provides versatility by shutting down opponent's artifacts. Overall, the deck is designed to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game in a single explosive turn.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while also utilizing powerful spells and artifacts to control the game. It includes cards like Force of Will, Hullbreacher, and Flusterstorm to counter spells and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also utilizes powerful tutors like Demonic Tutor and Vampiric Tutor to search for key cards like Time Walk, Timetwister, and Tinker. Additionally, it includes mana acceleration with Moxen and Wheel of Fortune, and win conditions like Bolas's Citadel and Time Vault. The goal is to control the game and overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells and card advantage.

This deck focuses on using artifacts to generate mana and combo off with spells like Tinker, Time Vault, and Trinisphere to control the game. It also includes cards like Mishra's Workshop, Urza's Saga, and Grim Monolith to accelerate the strategy. The addition of Paradoxical Outcome and Coveted Jewel allows the player to draw cards and generate more mana, ultimately leading to a win condition with cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Mystic Forge. The deck aims to be powerful and consistent in executing its combo strategy.

This deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly through cards like Tolarian Academy, Grim Monolith, and Mox Opal, while also using cards like Mishra's Workshop and Ancient Tomb. The goal is to use these resources to combo off with cards like Paradoxical Outcome and Coveted Jewel to draw a large number of cards and generate mana. The deck also contains several powerful tutor cards like Demonic Tutor and Mystical Tutor to find key combo pieces like Time Vault and Sensei's Divining Top. It also includes disruption in the form of Force of Will and Trinisphere to protect the combo.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly and efficiently using powerful artifacts like Black Lotus and Moxen, as well as Tolarian Academy and Urza's Saga. It also utilizes control elements like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Engineer Control cards like Goblin Engineer and Manifold Key allows for additional flexibility and combo potential, while Lurrus of the Dream-Den provides a valuable companion option for recursion and card advantage. The deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver opponents through resource management and strategic decision-making.

This deck focuses on utilizing cards like Underworld Breach, Tinker, and Time Vault to combo off and create a powerful board state quickly. It also includes plenty of card draw, counterspells, and fast mana to help enable the combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan. Key cards like Ancestral Recall, Black Lotus, and Bolas's Citadel provide additional power and consistency to the strategy. The deck aims to win the game in a quick and explosive manner, relying on efficient plays and strong synergy between the cards in the list.

The deck revolves around using Doomsday to set up a winning combo by manipulating the cards in the deck and utilizing powerful spells like Ancestral Recall, Black Lotus, and other fast mana cards to quickly assemble the necessary pieces. The deck also includes disruption spells like Force of Will and Duress to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to efficiently and quickly set up the Doomsday combo to win the game before the opponent can react effectively.
